info.name: Shopify Admin REST About Type API
Shopify Updates The Ordering Type Of Products In A Smart Collection

params.name: smart_collection_id
params.description: smart_collection_id

params.name: products
params.description: An array of product IDs, in the order that you want them to appear at the top of the collection. When products is specified but empty, any previously sorted products are cleared.

params.name: sort_order
params.description:
The type of sorting to apply. Valid values are listed in the Properties section above.
                  (default: (current value))
